description: This file contains unit tests for the SiloMetadata component of an Orleans-based project, verifying configuration, retrieval, and synchronization of silo metadata across cluster nodes.

classes.name: SiloMetadataTests
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests to verify the behavior of silo metadata configuration, retrieval, addition, and removal within an Orleans test cluster.

classes.name: SiloMetadataTestExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for verifying that silo metadata across different silos in a cluster are consistent and match expected keys.

methods.name: AssertAllSiloMetadataMatchesOnAllSilos
methods.description: Asserts that all silos in the cluster have consistent metadata for the specified expected keys.
